title: dryopteris pavoniana
intro: Dryopteris pavoniana, commonly known as the Crowned Shield Fern, is a species of fern native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The health benefits of Dryopteris pavoniana include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain, fever, and cough. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
